statement.p: Find all vectors \vec v in 2 dimensions having ||\vec v|| = 5 where the \,\mathit{\vec i}-component of \vec v is 3 \,\mathit{\vec i}.

p.em: (If you find more than one vector, enter them in a comma-separated list.)

static.solution: \vec v in the \,\mathit{\vec i}-direction is 3, we have \vec v = 3 \,\mathit{\vec i} + b \,\mathit{\vec j} for some b. Since ||\vec v|| = 5, we have \sqrt{3^2 + b^2} = 5^2, so b = 4 or b = -4. There are two vectors satisfying the properties given: \vec v = 3\,\mathit{\vec i}+4\,\mathit{\vec j}, 3\,\mathit{\vec i}-4\,\mathit{\vec j}.
